name: navigator
description: On long jobs, publishes an HTML progress page on its own, always at the same address.

enabled.title: Navigator enabled
enabled.description: Creates and updates the progress page on its own during long jobs.

step_threshold.title: Step threshold
step_threshold.description: The page starts when the plan reaches this number of steps.

cadence.title: Republish cadence
cadence.description: step-done: on every finished step. every-change: on every state change. block-done: when a whole block finishes. All three republish at once on blocked steps, new decisions and the end of the job.

publish_at_turn_end.title: Publish at the end of a turn
publish_at_turn_end.description: At the end of each turn, also publishes what the cadence left unpublished. Off, only the cadence decides (a failed publish is still retried).

notify.title: Push notifications
notify.description: Sends a push notification when a step is blocked or a decision opens, where notifications are available.

language.title: Page language
language.description: Language of the published page: en (English) or it (Italian).

theme.title: Colour theme
theme.description: Starting palette: standard, high-contrast or muted. Custom colours override it.

color_background.title: Colour: background
color_background.description: Page background, as hex (e.g. #1d5fc4). Empty = the theme's. Applies to the light and the dark version.

color_surface.title: Colour: surface
color_surface.description: Panels (summary and blocks), as hex (e.g. #1d5fc4). Empty = the theme's. Applies to the light and the dark version.

color_text.title: Colour: text
color_text.description: Text, as hex (e.g. #1d5fc4). Empty = the theme's. Applies to the light and the dark version.

color_accent.title: Colour: accent
color_accent.description: Accent: links, eyebrow, labels, as hex (e.g. #1d5fc4). Empty = the theme's. Applies to the light and the dark version.

color_done.title: Colour: done
color_done.description: "Done" state and progress bars, as hex (e.g. #1d5fc4). Empty = the theme's. Applies to the light and the dark version.

color_in_progress.title: Colour: in progress
color_in_progress.description: "In progress" state, as hex (e.g. #1d5fc4). Empty = the theme's. Applies to the light and the dark version.

color_blocked.title: Colour: blocked
color_blocked.description: "Blocked" state, as hex (e.g. #1d5fc4). Empty = the theme's. Applies to the light and the dark version.

color_todo.title: Colour: todo
color_todo.description: "To do" state, as hex (e.g. #1d5fc4). Empty = the theme's. Applies to the light and the dark version.

color_attention.title: Colour: attention
color_attention.description: The "Needs you" section, as hex (e.g. #1d5fc4). Empty = the theme's. Applies to the light and the dark version.

section_requirements.title: Requirements section
section_requirements.description: Shows the requirements covered by each block.

section_tests.title: Tests section
section_tests.description: Shows how many tests pass for each block.

section_pr.title: PR section
section_pr.description: Shows each block's pull request and its state.

section_screenshots.title: Screenshots section
section_screenshots.description: Shows the interface screenshots of each block.

show_done_steps.title: Show done steps
show_done_steps.description: Lists done steps too; off, it only counts them.

show_block_reasons.title: Show block reasons
show_block_reasons.description: Shows why a step is blocked.

show_decision_context.title: Show decision context
show_decision_context.description: Shows the context under each decision to make.

show_status_counts.title: Show status counts
show_status_counts.description: Shows how many steps are in progress, blocked, to do and done.

show_progress_bars.title: Show progress bars
show_progress_bars.description: Shows the overall, block and test progress bars.

collapse_done_blocks.title: Collapse done blocks
collapse_done_blocks.description: Collapses blocks whose steps are all done.

show_test_notes.title: Show test notes
show_test_notes.description: Shows the note under the test count.

show_times.title: Show times
show_times.description: Shows when the job started and how long steps have been in progress or blocked.

show_events.title: Show recent events
show_events.description: Shows the last 10 events: steps done or blocked, decisions, blocks and job done.

show_agents.title: Show agents at work
show_agents.description: Shows the subagents running when the page is published.
